description: This file 'VoiceWakeTextUtils.swift' contains utility functions for processing voice wake words and commands, including token normalization, trigger detection, and command extraction based on trigger phrases.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Converts a string token to lowercase and trims whitespace and punctuation.

methods.name: startsWithTrigger
methods.description: Checks if the transcript starts with any of the specified trigger phrases, considering normalized tokens.

methods.name: textOnlyCommand
methods.description: Extracts a command text from a transcript if it starts with a trigger and meets length requirements, after trimming the wake word.
